p.i: ut Ecclesiam[?] cum Republicâ tur-bent, atque omnia sursum deor-sum vertant? An non præsta-bit revocare eos maturè à moli-mine, impedire quominus im-pingant, adeoque à lapsu gravis-simo eos præservare? Id quod melius fieri non poterit, quàm ubi viderint, verâ doctrinâ jam benè imbutos esse animos à cujus cognitione omnibus mo-dis tum per calumnias, tum per alias artes homines prohibere conantur. Accedit quod lege non solùm naturæ, sed etiam verbi divini famam meam ho-nestam non paucis laboribus per

page.notes: The first word "Ecclesiam" is printed with letters that are hard to make out at this scan resolution; the reading is doubtful. The bracketed mark "(?)" printed beside the page number "7" at the foot is not transcribed: it may be a printer's mark or a stray symbol, and I could not read it with confidence. The long s (s) is written as a plain s, as the rules require. The text is set in italic throughout, apart from the roman "PRÆFATIO." heading.
